entries.mitigation: Spread behind the boss. When targeted, kite backward through the first pops and avoid dragging them through the group; experienced players can dodge through the final pop to return.
Whole group blocks the stomp. Healers immediately stabilize the bleed and push affected players back to full health.
Assigned ranged players stay furthest back, block the incoming shard, and place its poison area away from melee.
Everyone blocks the three-line pound, not just the tank. Keep the boss faced away and do not assume the lines stay only in front.
Dodge the projectile when possible. If afflicted, isolate until it expires because touching another player spreads the poison.
Kill each Overcharger wave immediately at 75%, 50%, and 25%; do not let the 1/2/3 spawn waves accumulate.
Keep the Overcharger near the door and kill every spawn quickly. Do not let the add drift through the raid.
Kill the totem, not the Shaman. Killing the Shaman creates another totem and makes Overcharger control worse.
Free pinned players immediately with the synergy. Prioritize tanks and healers first; up to four players can be pinned as the fight progresses.
Hard Mode: stay stacked until the projectile physically leaves the boss's hand, then sprint out together and return after it lands. Moving early places it badly.
Expect Mantikoras after poison phases 2 and 4. Off-tank them away from the group or bring them in for a controlled burn, but always block their heavy/stomp mechanics.
Spend magicka aggressively before detonation and get the bar down to roughly 0-10%; failing to drain it is lethal.
Dodge during the pull to break it early; otherwise roll away from the totem to clear the heavy snare and return to stack.
Kill poison totems to reduce poison-phase pressure because they buff the Serpent's poison damage.
